description.text: Curriculum Courses of Politics and Foreign Language are exempted; Introduction to China and Modern Chinese Language is required; - Others courses are taken as the same as Chinese students. - The student who has completed the curriculum, passed the examinations and successfully defended the dissertation will be issued a diploma and conferred with Doctoral degree.
